modelOverview: First introduced in 1983 and named for the flexible, brick-link bracelet that echoes the fluid movement of Cartier's emblematic panther, the Panthère de Cartier was relaunched in 2017 with its distinctive square case, screwed bezel and rail-track Roman numeral dial. The Medium model is the larger of the two core modern proportions, offered in full steel and in steel-and-yellow-gold combinations, and is worn as a versatile unisex quartz dress watch.

WSPA0013.materials: Stainless steel case and steel brick-link bracelet
WSPA0013.bezel: Square polished steel bezel with signature exposed screws
WSPA0013.dial: Silvered dial with Roman numerals, rail-track minute ring and blued-steel sword-shaped hands
WSPA0013.description: The Panthère de Cartier Medium in steel is the larger of the two modern core sizes, pairing the model's signature square case and screwed bezel with a silvered dial, Roman numerals and blued sword-shaped hands, worn on Cartier's flexible steel brick-link bracelet. Its crown is set with a synthetic blue spinel, a detail carried across the modern Panthère range. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

W2PN0006.materials: Stainless steel and 18k yellow gold case, and steel and 18k yellow gold brick-link bracelet
W2PN0006.bezel: Square polished steel and yellow gold bezel with signature exposed screws
W2PN0006.dial: Silvered dial with Roman numerals, rail-track minute ring and blued-steel sword-shaped hands
W2PN0006.description: The Panthère de Cartier in steel and yellow gold pairs the model's signature square case and screwed bezel with a silvered dial, Roman numerals and blued sword-shaped hands, worn on Cartier's flexible two-tone brick-link bracelet. Its crown is set with a synthetic blue spinel, a detail carried across the modern Panthère range. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

variants.Steel & Yellow Gold: Two-tone execution combining a stainless steel case and centre bracelet links with 18k yellow gold outer links and bezel, paired with the same silvered dial, Roman numerals and blued sword-shaped hands as the full-steel model.
